failure: Failure: No same-level nonlinear feedback, unbounded parent access, arbitrary nonlinear cellular automaton, full-state efficient sampling, or general full-chain O(log N) mixing theorem is established. Fixed-depth is essential to the recursive bound; low reset probability and larger depth can be practically prohibitive. Exactness assumes ideal independent randomness and does not follow from the source's pseudorandom statistical checks.
interface: Interface: States lie in F_q^c. At a site-time one shared category chooses independent uniform Haar values for all coordinates with probability s, a locally known residual reset with probability r, or a gate with probability 1-s-r. At level ell the gate is linear in level-ell parents plus a deterministic function of strictly lower-level inputs; same-level nonlinear feedback is excluded. Parent acquisition, forcing descriptions and their evaluation are charged. Rational s,r support ideal exact random-bit draws; the reference implementation covers prime q, while the note states a mathematical finite-field generalization.
